title: Optional: Sweep a Survivor Cache
briefing: A survivor cache is the safest way to turn scanner work into supplies. Confirm the marker, recover the cache, and log what it points toward next.

objectives.label: Scan the cache casing
objectives.detail: Confirm it is a survivor cache and not a hazard lure.

objectives.label: Recover useful supplies
objectives.detail: Take food, filters, repair parts, or map notes if present.

objectives.label: Log the cache route
objectives.detail: Return to Terminal Route Records so What Now can suggest a sensible next step.

rewards.label: Food, filters, and small repair parts

completionText: Cache swept. The route is now a known safe resupply point instead of another unknown signal.
